payload.session: uuid — the session the brief prepares; its scenes take the ranks after its last (scene-order-contiguous), its elements and media are its campaign's (scene-links-same-campaign)
payload.text: string — the brief typed, or transcribed by the micro-frontend; kept whole as the oral brief's transcript, the only thing sent to the llm port
payload.dictation: string — base64 of the dictated audio, read only when no text is given: transcribed locally through the speech-to-text port, the transcript taken as the brief; the audio is neither sent nor stored (text-only-no-audio)
payload.durationSeconds: integer — optional, how long the brief was dictated, in seconds; 0 when absent
